messages:
elena: Prism model family (prism-1, prism-1-small) is GA on Hosted as of now. This includes the new streaming schema v3 and an experimental toolcall multiplexer. Docs + migration guide: https://intranet.redwood/prism-ga :tada:

ops-bot: deploy: hosted/prism/ga -> succeeded 1768456792 :white_check_mark:

david_engineering: Nice. Whats the canary plan? Are we doing a phased rollout or flipping the switch?

elena: Phased. Canary -> 5% for first 2h, then 25% for 6h, then 100% if no regressions. Auto-fallback route -> prism-1-fallback (quantized variant).

mike_ops: Heads-up: streaming schema v3 changes framing for multiplexed streams. Ensure ingress proxies (nginx, edge-gateway) are upgraded to v2.4+. Otherwise clients may see truncated frames or malformed boundaries.

sanjay_research: prism-1-small: INT8 quantized kernels available. Typical chat workloads see ~3x token cost reduction with ~<2% avg quality delta on our eval sets. Full model card + evals in the docs.

amanda_cs: Do we need a customer-facing migration note? Enterprise teams will ask about SLAs and timelines.

elena: Yes  short email + migration guide. TL;DR: streaming schema v3 is backward-compatible for non-multiplexed streams. If you rely on toolcall multiplexing update client SDK to >= 3.6.0. We'll publish example diffs.

lisa_marketing: Ill draft an internal FAQ and short blog post. Amanda, can you surface customer tickets we should proactively address?

amanda_cs: Will pull top tickets and DM. Also flagging top 5 Dedicated customers who asked for lower-latency variants.

david_engineering: Quick test snippet for the new multiplexer:```
REDWOOD_API_KEY=... 
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"prism-1","streaming":"v3","multiplex":true,"tools":["search","calculator"]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```

ops-bot: rollout-check: canary metrics watchlist created -> prism-canary-watch (latency, error-rate, token-cost, hallucination-score).

sanjay_research: Note: prism-1 changes stop-sequence handling slightly vs older families. If you depend on exact token boundaries run your prompt suite through the eval harness before switching.

mike_ops: Rate-limit policy update: default per-route concurrency cap = 60 streams. Enterprise routes can opt into 120 by request. Added per-tool concurrent caps for multiplexing to reduce noisy-neighbor effects.

elena: Deprecation: realtime-v1 endpoints will be deprecated in 60 days. Well auto-redirect over the next 30 days with a compatibility shim but plan SDK updates. Deprecation note + timeline in the docs link above.

lisa_marketing: Blog draft ready for review @elena @amanda_cs. Will post in #announcements once approved.

david_engineering: Ill monitor infra dashboards during the 5% canary and report back at +2h. If anything looks off Ill open an incident channel.

elena: Quick checklist: update SDKs, publish migration guide, alert CS top customers, bump ingress proxies, monitor prism-canary-watch. If you see client regressions open an incident and tag @oncall.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled -> deprecation-notice-email goes out in 7 days to affected customers.
